"'''Talcharaim Mist-Night'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] recorded by [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] and played in the style of [[Wroonian blues]]. It is sometimes misspelled as "Telcharaim Mist-Night."<ref name="Spare Parts">{{JournalCite|11|Spare Parts (short story)}}</ref>
